metadata.case_name: CHEUNG WAI PING v. CHAN YUEN YEE

source: A CT brain scan showed a left parietal epidural haematoma and traumatic sub-arachnoid haemorrhage.
A CT brain scan showed a left parietal epidural haematoma and traumatic sub-arachnoid haemorrhage.

injuries.description: fracture of the left parietal bone
source: There was a fracture of the left parietal bone.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of parietal bone of skull

injuries.description: right frontal and temporal lobe contusional haematoma
source: On the following day, on a finding of right frontal and temporal lobe contusional haematoma, another craniotomy was performed.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic haemorrhage in brain tissue

source: He was left with a depression in his skull for which it was suggested that he undergo cranioplasty, but he has not done so.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of vault of skull, unspecified

source: he had ... left side lower and upper limb weakness.
Dr Woo found that the plaintiff suffered from residual cognitive dysfunction and left hemiparesis.
he had right side 3rd nerve palsy

injuries.description: dementia due to head trauma (Organic Mental Disorder)
source: they found that he was free from psychiatric disorder before the accident but now suffers from dementia due to head trauma.
He was diagnosed as having an Organic Mental Disorder and put on medication.
The plaintiff suffered severe head injuries.

manifestations.description: left hemiparesis / weakness of left upper and lower limbs
unable to resume pre-accident or any employment
cannot manage his family finances / incapable of managing and administering his property and affairs
needs to be accompanied when he goes out and supervised when he takes medicine
needs standby assistance for climbing stairs and outdoor ambulation

treatments_received: second craniotomy (for right frontal and temporal lobe contusional haematoma)
treatments_future: ongoing psychiatric treatment for three years
neurological follow-up visits (three 6-monthly visits up to March 2008 allowed by judge)

losses.description: Irreparable brain damage leading to inability to manage his own affairs; award for pain, suffering and loss of amenity $1,000,000.
Loss of society to his wife (section 20C(1) LARCO); award $80,000.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Loss of plaintiff's gratuitous services to his dependant (wife); award $80,000.
Unable to resume pre-accident employment or any employment; award for loss of earnings included in quantum.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Loss of interest in sex caused by the dementia.
Needs assistance/standby assistance for climbing stairs and outdoor ambulation.
Cannot manage family finances and requires supervision and accompaniment; wife acts as primary caregiver.
